name: Kundennote.com Bewertungssiegel
author: muto.at

sections.description:
Referral marketing as a new sales channel:
This is kundennote.com!

kundennote.com has been an independent review portal for every kind of business since 2015, from startups to large companies. It combines classic referral management with a trust seal for your website. Use your customers’ reviews and increase your revenue. Your customers are the best advertisement for your business.

Increase your revenue
Recommendations are the simplest way to win customers. You already know that from your business. Use the same approach online.

Bring all reviews together
Collect your reviews from different review sites in one profile and convince potential customers with transparency.

Review seals for your website
Reviews help only when people read them. The seals show them exactly where prospects learn about your business.

“Top service provider” award
Do you have many satisfied customers? Earn the kundennote.com top service provider award as a seal on your profile and as a printed certificate in the mail.

Reply to reviews
Respond to incoming reviews. Be transparent about good reviews and bad ones. Say thank you or state your position.

Stand out
Stand out in search results. Gain more visibility through review stars in search results.

Free registration at kundennote.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/kundennotecom directory, or install it with the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin under Settings, then kundennote.com.
  4. Add the review seal with the shortcodes [kundennote style="1"], [kundennote style="2"], and so on, or with the widget under Appearance, then Widgets.
sections.changelog:
3.1.8

  • The plugin admin and widget texts are now in English. German translations can be added on translate.wordpress.org.

3.1.7

  • Requires WordPress 7.1. The plugin runs on PHP 7.4 through 8.5.
  • PHP warnings no longer occur when no kundennote.com ID has been saved yet.
  • German seals are used for every German locale, including de_AT and de_CH, and follow the language of the current page.
  • The saved ID is limited to letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
  • Admin styles load only on the settings screen.
  • The alignment of one seal no longer overrides the alignment of another style.
